questions.text: Who always visits museums when they travel?
questions.expl: Daniel chia sẻ rằng anh ấy đến bảo tàng trong các kỳ nghỉ ở các thành phố mới.

questions.text: Who says it is important to visit the same museum several times?

questions.text: Who learns more in a museum than in a classroom?
questions.expl: Daniel học được nhiều điều từ việc nhìn các vật thực tế hơn là từ sách vở trên lớp.

questions.text: Who prefers going around a museum with a guide to going alone?
questions.expl: Emily cho rằng có hướng dẫn viên giải thích sẽ tốt hơn là cố gắng đọc các bảng thông báo.

sections.passage:
How I spend my free time
Jay Portman describes his unusual hobby, hill running, and tells us why he enjoys it.

Hill running is the sport of running up and down hills and mountains, through open countryside. It's not popular among my friends, but I love it. My dad took me and my brothers out running when we were little, and then when I was about fifteen, I joined a hill running club, called the York Merlins.

There are some excellent runners in the club. When we do our practice runs, I'm always a long way behind them. But that doesn't bother me. They're all really nice and often give me advice. What I love is being outdoors and finding all these beautiful places I never knew were there.

We race against other clubs at the weekends. In these races, runners are told where to finish, but not how to get there. You need a good map and compass so you don't get lost. Everyone starts together at the beginning, but later in the race you often find yourself running alone.

Anyone can enter these races – you just get there in the morning, pay your £5, and run. There are no T-shirts or medals for the winners. The most you get is a piece of cake! Often there are international hill running champions taking part, but they are just as friendly as everyone else.

That doesn't mean it's an easy sport. Last weekend I did a race in heavy rain and high winds, and I was asking myself what I was doing out there. But I got to the end, and that was an amazing feeling.

questions.text: Jay's first experience of hill running was with
questions.expl: My dad took me and my brothers out running when we were little.

questions.text: How does Jay feel about the good runners in his club?
questions.expl: When we do our practice runs, I'm always a long way behind them. But that doesn't bother me.
opts: He'd like to be as fast as them one day.
He doesn't mind that they are better than him.
He thinks they should help slower runners improve.

questions.text: What does Jay say is important in the races he enters?
questions.expl: You need a good map and compass so you don't get lost.
opts: being able to find your way

questions.text: What do we learn about the races from the fourth paragraph?
questions.expl: There are no T-shirts or medals for the winners. The most you get is a piece of cake!
opts: They are only for local runners.
They are free for some people to enter.

questions.text: What does Jay say about the last race he did?
questions.expl: But I got to the end, and that was an amazing feeling.
opts: The bad weather made it dangerous.
He was very happy when he finished it.
It wasn't as difficult as some races he has done.

sections.title: PART 4
sections.instr: For each question, choose the correct answer.
sections.passage:
Dakota Fanning
Dakota Fanning was born on February 23rd 1994, in Georgia, USA. She began acting classes at a very (19) __________ age and starred in her first TV advert when she was just five years old.
After that, she had a long and successful (20) __________ as a child actor in both TV shows and films. In 2001, she (21) __________ an important prize for her part in the film I am Sam. Over the next ten years, she acted with many big Hollywood stars, including Reese Witherspoon, Tom Cruise and Kurt Russell.
Dakota Fanning is different from many child actors because her success continued as she (22) __________ up and became an adult. In 2018, she (23) __________ to TV for the first time in ten years, starring in a popular police drama set in the nineteenth century, (24) __________ The Alienist.

questions.expl: [AI tự giải – cần kiểm tra] Cụm từ "at a very early age".
[AI tự giải – cần kiểm tra] Danh từ "career" phù hợp khi nói về sự nghiệp diễn xuất.
[AI tự giải – cần kiểm tra] Cụm từ "won an important prize".
[AI tự giải – cần kiểm tra] Cụm từ "grew up".
[AI tự giải – cần kiểm tra] Động từ "returned" đi với giới từ "to".
[AI tự giải – cần kiểm tra] Phân từ quá khứ "called" dùng để đặt tên.

sections.passage:
New Message
From: Tom
To: Rob

I'm writing (0) about my party on Saturday. Thanks so (25) __________ for offering to help me get everything ready. (26) __________ don't you come over to my place tomorrow (27) __________ school? We can have dinner together and start planning. (28) __________ are lots of things to think about!

Also, I wanted to (29) __________ you know that I'm going to invite a girl called Hannah to the party. She's just moved into the house next door to mine, so it will (30) __________ a good way for her to meet people and make friends.

Text me if you can come tomorrow.

questions.text: I'm writing (0) about my party on Saturday. Thanks so (25) {{much}} for offering to help me get everything ready. (26) {{Why}} don't you come over to my place tomorrow (27) {{after}} school? We can have dinner together and start planning. (28) {{There}} are lots of things to think about! Also, I wanted to (29) {{let}} you know that I'm going to invite a girl called Hannah to the party. She's just moved into the house next door to mine, so it will (30) {{be}} a good way for her to meet people and make friends. Text me if you can come tomorrow.

You want to go clothes shopping on Saturday with your friend Ashley.
Write an email to Ashley.
In your email:
• ask Ashley to go shopping with you this Saturday
• explain why you need to buy new clothes
• suggest where to go shopping
Write 25 words or more.
questions.sample: Hi Ashley, Would you like to go shopping with me this Saturday? I need to buy some new clothes because I am growing fast and my old jacket is too small for me now. I would like to go to the new department store in the town centre. It has a big sale! See you soon, Alex

questions.text:
Look at the three pictures.
Write the story shown in the pictures.
Write 35 words or more.
questions.sample: Last Saturday, Jane and Susan went to an outdoor music concert. At first, they showed their tickets to the staff at the gate and walked inside. After that, they sat on the grass and had a nice picnic with delicious sandwiches and cold drinks. When the music started, they danced together in the crowd and had a wonderful time!
